source.source_locator: 教則 第6章 6.2「気象の影響」(1)2)f.「山谷風」

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 山岳地帯では昼間は谷風、夜間は山風が吹く。
evidence.tested_misconception: 山谷風は昼夜で方向が変わらない。
evidence.reasoning_path: mountain terrain + time of day -> heating/cooling -> valley-up day or mountain-down night wind

collision.note: Tier A。Q270は海陸風と朝凪・夕凪を問う。本問は山岳地形に固有の山谷風の昼夜反転を問う。

independent_review.rationale: Mountain/valley wind has a terrain-specific day/night reversal mechanism distinct from Q270's sea/land-breeze mechanism and calm transition periods.
